1.text: Nuko iminsi mikuru y'imitsima idasembuwe yitwa Pasika, yendaga gusohora.

2.text: Abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi bashaka uko bamwica, kuko batinyaga rubanda.

3.text: Satani yinjira muri Yuda witwaga Isikariyota, yari mu mubare w'abo cumi na babiri.

4.text: Aragenda avugana n'abatambyi bakuru n'abatware b'abasirikare, uko azamubagenzereza.

6.text: Aremera maze ashaka uburyo yamubagenzereza, rubanda rudahari.

7.text: Nuko umunsi w'imitsima idasembuwe urasohora, ari wo ukwiriye kubāgirwamo umwana w'intama wa Pasika.

8.text: Atuma Petero na Yohana ati “Nimugende mudutunganirize ibya Pasika kugira ngo turye.”

10.text: Arabasubiza ati “Dore nimumara kugera mu murwa, muraza guhura n'umugabo wikoreye ikibindi cy'amazi, mumukurikire mu nzu ari bwinjiremo.

11.text: Nuko mubwire nyir'inzu muti ‘Umwigisha arakubaza ngo: Icumbi riri hehe, aho ari busangirire ibya Pasika n'abigishwa be?’

12.text: Na we ari bubereke icyumba kinini cyo hejuru giteguye, abe ari ho mubitunganiriza.”

13.text: Baragenda babisanga uko yabibabwiye, batunganya ibya Pasika.

14.text: Igihe gisohoye aricara ngo afungure, kandi intumwa na zo zicarana na we.

15.text: Arazibwira ati “Kwifuza nifujije gusangira namwe Pasika iyi, ntarababazwa.

16.text: Ndababwira yuko ntazongera rwose kuyirya, kugeza aho izasohorera mu bwami bw'Imana.”

17.text: Yenda igikombe aragishimira, arababwira ati “Mwende iki musangire.

18.text: Ndababwira yuko uhereye none ntazanywa ku mbuto z'imizabibu, ukageza aho ubwami bw'Imana buzazira.”

19.text: Yenda umutsima arawushimira, arawumanyagura arawubaha, arababwira ati “Uyu ni umubiri wanjye [ubatangiwe. Mujye mukorera mutya kugira ngo munyibuke.”

20.text: N'igikombe akigenza atyo bamaze kurya ati “Iki gikombe ni isezerano rishya ryo mu maraso yanjye ava ku bwanyu.]

21.text: “Ariko dore ukuboko k'ungambanira kuri kumwe n'ukwanjye ku meza.

22.text: Kuko Umwana w'umuntu agenda nk'uko byamugenewe, ariko uwo muntu umugambanira azabona ishyano!”

23.text: Batangira kubazanya muri bo, uwenda kugira atyo uwo ari we.

24.text: Maze habyuka impaka muri bo, ngo ni nde muri bo ukwiriye gutekerezwa ko ari we mukuru.

25.text: Arababwira ati “Abami b'amahanga barayategeka, n'abafite ubutware bwo kuyatwara bitwa ba ruhekerababyeyi.

26.text: Ariko mwebweho ntimukabe mutyo, ahubwo ukomeye muri mwe abe nk'uworoheje, n'utwara abe nk'uhereza.

27.text: Umukuru ni uwuhe? Ni uherezwa cyangwa ni uhereza? Si uherezwa? Ariko jyewe ndi hagati yanyu meze nk'uhereza.

28.text: “Ni mwe mwagumanye nanjye, twihanganana mu byo nageragejwe.

29.text: Nanjye mbabikiye ubwami nk'uko Data yabumbikiye,

30.text: kugira ngo muzarye munywe mwegereye ameza yanjye mu bwami bwanjye. Kandi muzicara ku ntebe z'icyubahiro, mucire imanza imiryango cumi n'ibiri y'Abisirayeli.”

31.text: Kandi Umwami Yesu aravuga ati “Simoni, Simoni, dore Satani yabasabye kugira ngo abagosore nk'amasaka,

32.text: ariko weho ndakwingingiye ngo kwizera kwawe kudacogora. Nawe numara guhinduka ukomeze bagenzi bawe.”

33.text: Aramubwira ati “Mwami, niteguye kujyana nawe mu nzu y'imbohe ndetse no mu rupfu.”

34.text: Aramubwira ati “Petero, ndakubwira yuko uyu munsi inkoko itaza kubika, utaranyihakana gatatu ko utanzi.”

35.text: Kandi arababaza ati “Ubwo nabatumaga mudafite impago, cyangwa imvumba cyangwa inkweto, mbese hari icyo mwakennye?”Baramusubiza bati “Nta cyo.”

36.text: Arababwira ati “Ariko nonaha ufite uruhago rurimo ifeza arujyane, n'ufite imvumba ni uko. Ariko utabifite agure umwitero we, ngo abone kugura inkota.

37.text: Ndababwira yuko ibi byanditswe bikwiriye kunsohoraho, ngo ‘Yabaranywe n'abagome’, kuko ibyanjye byenda gusohora.”

38.text: Baramubwira bati “Mwami, dore inkota ebyiri ngizi.”Arababwira ati “Ziramaze!”

39.text: Arasohoka ajya ku musozi wa Elayono nk'uko yamenyerey, abigishwa be baramukurikira.

40.text: Agezeyo arababwira ati “Nimusenge kugira ngo mutajya mu moshya.”

41.text: Atandukana na bo umwanya ureshya n'ahaterwa ibuye, arapfukama arasenga ati

42.text: “Data, nubishaka undenze iki gikombe, ariko bye kuba uko nshaka, ahubwo bibe uko ushaka.” [

43.text: Marayika uvuye mu ijuru aramubonekera, amwongera imbaraga

44.text: kuko yari ababaye bikabije, asenga cyane, n'ibyuya bye byari bimeze nk'ibitonyanga by'amaraso bitonyanga hasi.]

45.text: Amaze gusenga arahaguruka ajya ku bigishwa be, asanga basinjirijwe n'agahinda.

46.text: Arababaza ati “Ikibasinjirije ni iki? Nimubyuke musenge kugira ngo mutajya mu moshya.”

47.text: Akibivuga haza igitero kizanywe n'uwitwa Yuda, umwe muri abo cumi na babiri akigiye imbere. Nuko Yuda uwo yegera Yesu ngo amusome.

48.text: Yesu aramubaza ati “Yuda, uragambanishiriza Umwana w'umuntu kumusoma?”

49.text: Abari kumwe na we babonye ibyenda kubaho baramubaza bati “Databuja, tubakubite inkota?”

50.text: Umwe muri bo ayikubita umugaragu w'Umutambyi mukuru, amuca ugutwi kw'iburyo.

51.text: Yesu aravuga ati “Rekera aho.” Amukora ku gutwi aragukiza.

52.text: Yesu abwira abatambyi bakuru n'abatware b'abasirikare barinda urusengero, n'abakuru bamuteye ati “Munteye nk'abateye umwambuzi, mufite inkota n'inshyimbo.

53.text: Nahoranaga namwe mu rusengero iminsi yose, ko mutarambuye amaboko ngo mumfate? Ariko noneho iki ni igihe cyanyu n'icy'ubutware bw'umwijima.”

54.text: Baramufata baramujyana, bamushyira mu nzu y'Umutambyi mukuru, ariko Petero amukurikira arenga ahinguka.

55.text: Nuko bamaze gucana umuriro mu rugo hagati baricara, Petero na we yicara hagati yabo.

56.text: Umuja amubonye yicaye ahabona aramwitegereza aravuga ati “N'uyu na we yari kumwe na we.”

58.text: Hashize umwanya muto, undi aramubona aramubwira ati “Nawe uri uwo muri bo.”Petero ati “Wa muntu we, si ndi uwabo.”

59.text: Hashize umwanya nk'isaha imwe, undi amuhamiriza abikomeje cyane ati “Ni ukuri n'uyu yari kumwe na we, kuko ari Umunyagalilaya.”

60.text: Petero ati “Wa muntu we, icyo uvuze sinzi icyo ari cyo.”Akibivuga, muri ako kanya inkoko irabika.

61.text: Umwami Yesu arakebuka yitegereza Petero, nuko Petero yibuka amagambo Umwami yari yamubwiye ati “Uyu munsi inkoko itarabika, uri bunyihakane gatatu.”

63.text: Abagabo bari bafashe Yesu baramushinyagurira, baramukubita,

64.text: bamupfuka mu maso baramubaza bati “Hanura, ni nde ugukubise?”

66.text: Nuko iryo joro rikeye abakuru b'ubwo bwoko baraterana, ari bo batambyi bakuru n'abanditsi, bamujyana mu rukiko rwabo bati

67.text: “Niba uri Kristo, tubwire.”Arababwira ati “Nubwo nababwira ntimwabyemera na hato,

69.text: Ariko uhereye none, Umwana w'umuntu azaba yicaye iburyo bw'ubushobozi bw'Imana.”

70.text: Bose bati “Noneho uri Umwana w'Imana?”Arabasubiza ati “Mwakabimenye ko ndi we.”

71.text: Na bo bati “Turacyashakira iki abagabo, ko twumvise ubwacu abyivugiye ubwe?”
